title: BFB Shop tags
description: The shop's dynamic tags, group BFB Shop in Bricks' picker. `argument` is what goes after the colon; `contexts` where the tag answers (text, link, image); `live` the key it is filled in by after the page loads (right on cached pages); `follows` the fact it changes with when a variation is chosen; `inPageText` false means it answers in an element's own settings only, never in a post's or a review's text. Generated by dev/skills-export.php from the registries in the plugins; never edited by hand.
